Mulberry32

Original C algorithm: Tommy Ettinger
https://gist.github.com/tommyettinger/46a874533244883189143505d203312c

Written in 2017 by Tommy Ettinger (tommy.ettinger@gmail.com)

To the extent possible under law, the author has dedicated all copyright
and related and neighboring rights to this software to the public domain

See <http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/>.

JavaScript implementation: bryc
https://github.com/bryc/code/blob/master/jshash/PRNGs.md#mulberry32
The upstream file declares: "License: Public domain."

Used in tools/social-card.mjs, function seeded().
Changes: renamed state variable and compacted the JavaScript closure.
The generator is a development tool for deterministic social-card images.
